test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 11 July 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
The ages of seven students of a tuition class, Prem, Qazi, Rishav, Subham, Tania, Urvashi and Vinita, are as follows:

Prem is the second oldest. Vinita is older than only one person in the class. Subham is older than Tania but younger than Prem. Three students are older than Tania and three are younger than Tania. Neither Rishav nor Qazi is the youngest.

Given that no two students have the same age, who is the youngest?
solution:
**Given : **

 
• **Seven students of a tuition class → **Prem, Qazi, Rishav, Subham, Tania, Urvashi and Vinita.

**​Explanation :**

1) Prem is the second oldest. 

2) Vinita is older than only one person in the class.

_ > Prem > _ > _ > _ > Vinita > _

3) Three students are older than Tania and three are younger than Tania.

_ > Prem > _ > Tania > _ > Vinita > _

4) Subham is older than Tania but younger than Prem. 

_ > Prem > Subham > Tania > _ > Vinita > _

5) Neither Rishav nor Qazi is the youngest.

As neither Rishav nor Qazi is the youngest, so the only student is left is Urvashi who will be the youngest one.

As neither Rishav nor Qazi age is clear, therefore there are two possible answers:

**Rishav > Prem > Subham > Tania > Qazi > Vinita > Urvashi **

or,

**Qazi > Prem > Subham > Tania > Rishav > Vinita > Urvashi**

Thus, according to final two arrangements Urvashi is youngest in both the cases.

Hence, **"Urvashi"** is the correct answer.
